messages:
Maya: Quick note — legal flagged some example outputs that look real. With the v1->v2 deprecations plus the model alias swap coming, we need a short migration guide, sanitized snippets, and a link audit.
Jun: I can run a repo-wide grep for emails, phone numbers, and common key patterns and replace with <EMAIL>/<PHONE>/<REDACTED_KEY>. Will open small PRs with preview builds.
Oliver: For SDKs the key breaking changes: models.generate -> responses.create, and createEmbedding(dimension=...) -> embeddings.create(vector_dim=...). I'll prepare side-by-side JS/Python/curl examples.
Maya: Samples used in onboarding are highest priority. Add a deprecation banner to v1 pages linking to the migration guide and set up redirects to avoid 404s.
Jun: Plan: (1) automated replace + report, (2) manual sweep for false positives, (3) incremental PRs to keep previews small. Branch: docs/sanitize-3065.
Oliver: Snippet examples I'll land in a single docs PR: short curl/TS/py v1 vs v2. Example: `curl ... /v1/generate` vs `/v2/responses`. Also note model alias swap: `open-quant-7b` -> `redwood-q-7b`.
legal-bot: Replace any literal-looking personal data with synthetic tokens and add footer: "Examples sanitized for privacy." Tagging: @legal-team.
ci-bot: docs-smoke: note that doc-runner expects v1 names; recommend a temporary shim so CI doesn't fail while snippets are updated.
Maya: Assignments: Jun (sanitize script + PRs), Oliver (snippets + migration guide draft), Maya (banners + redirects + legal coord). Please paste PR links here as you open them.
Jun: Ack — will post PRs incrementally.
Oliver: Ack — will include compatibility notes and a tiny changelog blurb.
Maya: Timeline: start PRs tomorrow, merge small batches during the week, banners live on staging by Friday.
